title: A bare URL is a link: See https://kotlinlang.org/docs.

clause.text: A bare `http://`, `https://` or `www.` URL in the body is a link, as on GitHub (GFM's autolinks): at the start of the text or after a space, `*`, `_`, `~` or `(`, without its trailing punctuation, an unmatched `)` or an `&`: "See https://kotlinlang.org/docs." links `https://kotlinlang.org/docs`
